headline: Knee-high but clean ESE on a prime angle — dawn log or nothing.
today: There's a proper ESE line at 9-plus seconds hitting the right angle, but it's only about a foot so this is a small, clean, glassy affair at best. Morning NW is cross-off, so go early on the incoming toward the 9:31 high before the S onshore fills in for the afternoon. Log only, and keep expectations low.

daysToWatch.note: Best day of the stretch — SSE building to 3ft-plus at short period with cross-off to light NW wind all morning. Shortboard or groveler, ride the incoming, target midday when it goes light.
S onshore ramps to 17-19mph by afternoon and the swell's small. Dawn glass window only, then it's blown junk.
Prime ESE angle around 2ft with cross-off NW and a light afternoon. Short-period so it'll be soft, but clean and worth a fish session.
